verdict.rationale: Grok Build is documented as a local TUI/headless coding agent. It can plan, edit, run tests in the background (e.g. `/loop` checking the test suite), and share or export sessions for review. Headless mode with device-code auth could be self-run on a remote machine, but no first-party cloud agent is documented. missing for 10: a hosted cloud agent runtime, any demo artifacts (screenshots, video, preview deploys) of the built feature, a documented end-to-end build→test→demo review handoff, and independent hands-on corroboration.
